premises.text: Customer service is widely poor; public ratings of interactions can improve service by shining a bright light on it
premises.evidence_span: by shining a bright light on it, customer service gets better

premises.text: A mobile app lets consumers rate individual service employees in about 30 seconds with comments and social sharing
premises.evidence_span: in 30 seconds or less, you just provided not only that employee, but also their manager with information about that interaction

premises.text: Consumers can look up employee ratings before choosing whom to deal with
premises.evidence_span: before you went down to the car dealership, you could find out something about the people who are selling you the product

premises.text: A business dashboard aggregates ratings for benchmarking, employee performance, and customer-response requests
premises.evidence_span: dashboard for businesses where they can go in and at a glance see what's going on with their business

premises.text: Distribution via app stores, social networks, location-app integrations, and partner promotion at points of sale drives rating coverage
premises.evidence_span: they will actually promote Tello to their customers and have either buttons they wear or signs at the point of sale

value.text: Customer service improves when people can rate service interactions on their phones
value.evidence_span: empower people to rate customer service on their cell phones

secondary_value.text: Businesses get actionable visibility into employee service and customer follow-up requests

causal_links.evidence_span: by shining a bright light on it, customer service gets better
compare themselves against other businesses on customer service

notes: Investor list and t-shirt promo excluded. Multiple demo flows folded into one consumer-rating premise (v1.3.2 clarification 5). Singleton D2/D3 retained as business portal and GTM modules separately revisable from the consumer app.
